import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem normalClosure_union_eq_sup {G : Type*} [Group G] (S T : Set G) :
  Subgroup.normalClosure (S ∪ T) =
    Subgroup.normalClosure S ⊔ Subgroup.normalClosure T := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Subgroup.normalClosure_subset_iff).mp
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact
        (le_sup_left :
          Subgroup.normalClosure S ≤
            Subgroup.normalClosure S ⊔ Subgroup.normalClosure T)
          (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := S) hx)
    · exact
        (le_sup_right :
          Subgroup.normalClosure T ≤
            Subgroup.normalClosure S ⊔ Subgroup.normalClosure T)
          (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (s := T) hx)
  · apply sup_le
    · exact Subgroup.normalClosure_mono Set.subset_union_left
    · exact Subgroup.normalClosure_mono Set.subset_union_right

    · exact Subgroup.mem_sup_left (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure hx)
